document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You run until you fall, utterly spent. When you look back, you 
hear and see nothing. You are safe for the moment. But, now, 
you must face the Big Woods alone.
